title: NoveltyScope: A Multi-Agent Research Assistant for Evidence-Grounded Novelty Assessment of Scientific Papers
abstract: arXiv:2610.22703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: NoveltyScope is a prototype that compares a scientific paper with retrieved prior work and produces a structured report and a five-level novelty score. The system extracts the core task and at most two author-claimed contributions, then searches a closed local corpus using BM25 and dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion. Contribution comparisons request paired passages for potential refutations, and quotations are checked against cached source text. Four scoring roles (Prosecutor, Defender, Judge, and Critic) use the resulting evidence, with at most one revision of the Judge's score. Evaluation uses 50 class-balanced RINoBench samples whose idea-level labels are retained for full-paper input. Mean absolute error is 1.48 and 1.26 for single-LLM and multi-agent scoring with Gemini, respectively, and 1.22 and 1.16 with Qwen3. The vector-similarity baseline has an error of 1.68. translated_title: NoveltyScope：一个用于基于证据的学术论文新颖性评估的多智能体研究助手
translated_abstract: NoveltyScope是一个原型系统，它将一篇科学论文与检索到的先前工作进行对比，并生成结构化报告和五级新颖性评分。该系统提取论文的核心任务以及最多两个作者声称的贡献，然后使用BM25与稠密检索相结合倒数排名融合的方法，在一个封闭的本地语料库中进行搜索。贡献对比时会为潜在的反驳观点请求配对的文本段落，并且所有引文都会与缓存的源文本进行核对。四个评分角色（控方、辩方、法官和评论家）基于由此产生的证据进行评分，法官的评分最多只进行一次修订。评估使用了50个类别均衡的RINoBench样本，其中想法层面的标签被保留用于全文输入。使用Gemini时，单LLM评分和多智能体评分的平均绝对误差分别为1.48和1.26；使用Qwen3时分别为1.22和1.16。向量相似度基线的误差为1.68。HiCLIP案例研究展示了贡献对比的具体效果。
tldr: 论文提出NoveltyScope，一个通过检索先前工作、请求配对反驳证据并核对引文，由控方、辩方、法官和评论家四个智能体角色对论文作者声称的贡献进行基于证据的新颖性评估并输出五级评分的多智能体研究助手，其在RINoBench上的误差优于单LLM评分和向量相似度基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NoveltyScope, a multi-agent research assistant that performs evidence-grounded novelty assessment of scientific papers by retrieving prior work, requesting paired refutation passages, and verifying quotations, with four scoring roles (Prosecutor, Defender, Judge, and Critic) producing a five-level score that outperforms single-LLM scoring and a vector-similarity baseline on RINoBench.
